condition: suspected third trimester antepartum hemorrhage or placental abruption presenting with acute heavy dark red vaginal bleeding at 34 weeks gestation
level_rationale: Sudden heavy dark red vaginal bleeding today at 34 weeks gestation in a 29-year-old woman indicates life-threatening third-trimester antepartum hemorrhage such as placental abruption or placenta previa requiring immediate hospital obstetric triage, maternal resuscitation, and continuous fetal monitoring, whereas noticing new pink stretch marks across the lower belly this week at 34 weeks gestation describes normal physiological striae gravidarum managed with home self-care.

design_note: Uses three strictly atomic reference facts (29-year-old woman, 34 weeks pregnant, and sudden heavy dark red vaginal bleeding today) with a 1-word span difference (12 vs 13 words) and 8 shared trailing tokens ('today so I need to go to the'). Replacing f3 with new pink stretch marks across the lower belly this week stays directly inside the 34-week third-trimester pregnancy context under Rule A and Rule D while shifting care cleanly from emergency hospital obstetric evaluation (level 4) to home self-care (level 1) with zero stated negatives.
